actions.description: Verify write, restart durability, enabled state
actions.command:
# write a new record through the public proxy
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "put:%{http_code}\n" -X PUT --data-binary 'gamma-fresh' http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-gamma-001
